name: worktime3
description: Enterprise + individual time tracking (NestJS + React + Postgres + Keycloak + Caddy)

scripts.dev:up: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:down: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.dev:logs: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@worktime3/api && node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run start --workspace=@worktime3/api
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run dev --workspace=@worktime3/web
scripts.dev:migrate: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev:status: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run db:status
scripts.dev:seed: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:introspect: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run db:introspect
scripts.dev:checkschema: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev npm run db:checkschema
scripts.dev:psql: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.dev.yml exec pg psql -U worktime worktime
scripts.local:up: node scripts/with-env.mjs local docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build
scripts.local:down: node scripts/with-env.mjs local docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.local:logs: node scripts/with-env.mjs local docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.local.yml logs -f
scripts.local:migrate: node scripts/with-env.mjs local npm run db:migrate
scripts.local:status: node scripts/with-env.mjs local npm run db:status
scripts.local:seed: node scripts/with-env.mjs local npm run db:seed
scripts.local:introspect: node scripts/with-env.mjs local npm run db:introspect
scripts.local:checkschema: node scripts/with-env.mjs local npm run db:checkschema
scripts.local:psql: node scripts/with-env.mjs local docker compose -f compose/docker-compose.local.yml exec pg psql -U worktime worktime
